grants.caption: The set shown is an upper bound, not the set: a token not excluded here may still be refused by AWS.
grants.witnessCaption: The decoded payload. A claim not shown and not named by the grant is unconstrained, but for azp; sub is not shown because it was not evaluated, so whether it excludes a token is not decided here. It sets no azp: AWS reads aud from azp whenever a token sets one.
